newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to sell more one-year Treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to sell more one-year Treasury bills.

text.p: The Philippines' Bureau of Treasury said on Thursday it will increase its weekly offer of one-year Treasury bills to 2.5 billion pesos from 2.0 billion pesos.
But it decided to cut the volume for the three-month bills to 1.0 billion pesos from 1.5 billion pesos.
The changes will take effect next week.
Its total weekly offer will remain unchanged at 5.0 billion pesos.
A Bureau of Treasury official said the volume for one-year bills was increased to satisfy demand.
